about: More tokens for the Robinhood Chain MAINNET (4663) factory deployed on 2026-10-12, listed through its timelock: one scheduleBatch the Safe signs, and 48 hours later the same batch's executeBatch (script/AddAssets.s.sol prints both and holds this file to the chain; pnpm ops:add-assets writes them as the Safe app's Transaction Builder files). Tokens: MSTR, CRCL, USO, PLTR, WETH, cbBTC, DELL, SPCX, COIN, TSM, BABA, SGOV with a v4 pool; QQQ, MU, AMD, INTC, SLV with a v3 pool (`v3Pool`, Thom's option B, 2026-10-14), listed now and kept out of the app until it builds a v3 route. Each entry is an entry of the deploy file's shape (script/config/4663.json) with how a person reads it (symbol, name, kind), and each was held to the bar the nine of the deploy met (docs/vault/MAINNET-WIDER-LIST.md, gate WIDER-LIST): a Chainlink feed that names its aggregator and is live, a hookless Uniswap v4 pool (or, for the five, a Uniswap v3 pool) against USDG that fills $1,000 each way for 1% or less with its mid within 2% of the feed, and on a fork a vault that buys $500 of it and sells half back within 2% of the feed. The pool is the deepest that meets that, maxTradeUsd the largest size asked that cost 1% or less each way, maxWeightBps DESIGN-VAULT section 6 on the pool's sale capacity, average the deepest Uniswap v3 pool against USDG (usable only with more than 3,600 observations). The keeper stays off: flags 0, no average feed, no range. Every value is PROPOSED: the Safe's two owners confirm them by signing the schedule. Figures read by packages/chain-evm/test/pool-quotes.ts (method pool-quotes-0.2) at the blocks in `measured`; each note names its own.
salt: tenonfi robinhood-mainnet more tokens and registry v2 2026-10-14
